veranderings.voor: 'n sorgsentrum in Johannesburg vir mense met MIV
veranderings.na: 'n sorgsentrum vir mense met MIV in Johannesburg
veranderings.rede: Keeping 'vir mense met MIV' next to 'sorgsentrum' reads more naturally, and the place goes after it.

veranderings.voor: omdat daardie kind MIV het nie
veranderings.na: omdat die kind MIV het nie
veranderings.rede: 'daardie kind' points back stiffly to a child just named; 'die kind' is smoother and means the same.

vlae.teks: Almal het na 'n groter plek suid van Johannesburg getrek.
vlae.rede: 'Almal' has no clear referent (the residents, the staff, the organisation?); making it specific would mean guessing who moved, so it is flagged, not changed.

beskerm_bedenkings.rede: The protected entry says to keep 'VIGS', but the lesson writes 'vigs' in lower case in the reading piece and in the glossary headword; AWS 2017 spells it 'vigs'. Not changed; a person should decide which spelling the lesson keeps so the entry and the text agree.
